whatTheChangeActuallyDoes: Gap audit: 67 portal-referenced collections cross-checked against CREATE TABLE coverage in schema history; 8 missing (attendance_records, attendance_sessions, departments, event_registrations, events, households, people_departments, visitors). New migration 20261020_0020 (AFC-566): CREATE TABLE households (expansion 4.1 shape incl. zone, wedding_date, household_head), departments (2.2 incl. nullable branch, leader_person), people_departments (2.4 junction, UNIQUE pair, unlink-deactivates), ALTER TABLE people ADD COLUMN household (never a forked people table); FK policy per data-model 7 (branch parents RESTRICT, junction CASCADE, person links SET NULL); directus_app SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE, NO DELETE; GRANT UPDATE (household) ON people (minimal column-scoped ceiling for link/unlink). Conditional overlap with 0002 hierarchy blocks stated (IF NOT EXISTS no-ops). Down script refuses while rows or live links exist, drops in dependency order, no CASCADE/TRIGGER. Suite 85 pins shape, enums, FK/delete semantics, 0002 re-apply overlap, app guards (42501 on DELETE), idempotent rerun, empty rollback, zero-orphan acceptance. Suite 70.6 updated from households-absent to 0020-owned-with-full-shape (the no-fork invariant, positively pinned). All ten household/department routes wrap 0020-table reads/writes in try/catch to throwStoreUnavailable(error, household_store|department_store, 0020) with deliberate 4xx (scope 404s, 409 conflict, validation) passing through -- a refinement over AFC-550's catch-all, stated in code comments. Web contract gains 7 hardening assertions. No data backfill, no seeds (board-shaped/family data). Suites 70.6/77 updated to 0023-owned positive pins; suite 81 seeds a real session for its counts import; 86.7 proves the documented reverse order (0023 before 0021). deviationsStated: Two. (1) people gains one UPDATE grant on the household column only; every other people column keeps the 0004 ceiling -- the smallest widening that lets link/unlink work, stated in the migration header. (2) 4xx passthrough in route catch blocks refines AFC-550 (whose catch-all would rename a scope 404 into pending_migration): deliberate client errors keep their codes, only unreadable stores are renamed. Both recorded in code comments, not silent.
